description: This file defines the class 'jirarestInterface' which extends 'issueTrackerInterface' and provides methods for integrating with Jira REST API, including issue retrieval, creation, comments, and configuration handling.

classes.name: jirarestInterface
classes.description: A class for integrating with Jira REST API, managing issues, comments, and configuration.

methods.name: getIssueAttr
methods.description: Returns the issue attributes.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes and sets default configuration properties for Jira API endpoints.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the API client object.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Checks if the issue ID has a valid syntax.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to Jira API and verifies project and statuses.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the connection to Jira API is established.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves issue details from Jira by issue ID.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the status code of an issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Returns the verbose status of an issue.

methods.name: getIssueSummaryHTMLString
methods.description: Returns the HTML string for the issue summary.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if an issue exists in Jira.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue in Jira with specified summary, description, and options.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a comment to an existing Jira issue.

methods.name: getIssueTypes
methods.description: Retrieves available issue types from Jira.

methods.name: getPriorities
methods.description: Retrieves available priorities from Jira.

methods.name: getVersions
methods.description: Retrieves project versions from Jira.

methods.name: getComponents
methods.description: Retrieves project components from Jira.

methods.name: getCreateIssueFields
methods.description: Retrieves fields required for creating issues in Jira.

methods.name: getIssueTypesForHTMLSelect
methods.description: Returns issue types formatted for HTML select input.

methods.name: getPrioritiesForHTMLSelect
methods.description: Returns priorities formatted for HTML select input.

methods.name: getVersionsForHTMLSelect
methods.description: Returns versions formatted for HTML select input.

methods.name: getComponentsForHTMLSelect
methods.description: Returns components formatted for HTML select input.

methods.name: objectAttrToIDName
methods.description: Converts attribute set objects to ID-name pairs.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template configuration XML for Jira integration.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Checks if issue creation via API is possible based on configuration.

methods.name: processAttributes
methods.description: Processes custom attribute values for Jira issues.

methods.name: getCustomFieldsAttribute
methods.description: Extracts and sets custom field attributes for Jira issues.

methods.name: checkCfg
methods.description: Validates the configuration for Jira connection.

methods.name: setResolvedStatusCfg
methods.description: Sets the resolved status configuration.

methods.name: getUserAccountID
methods.description: Retrieves Jira user account ID by email.
